confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors follow Shenzhen city-level typical-price data from around the requested period. Cocktail and restaurant wine prices are less certain; they are estimated at several times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, with limited comparable-city context.
comparable_city_reasoning: Shenzhen's major business and technology hub demand suggests room prices somewhat above the supplied Beijing, Xiamen, Harbin and Sanya comparables, while basic guesthouses and hostels remain lower-cost options.
